scope: The rule paraphrases and exact ISO locators below were checked against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text (ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.txt): PDF string-decoding/spacing interfaces, supported font dictionaries and embedding bindings, character selection, widths/CID metrics, PDF-specific CMap rules and ToUnicode. Every code-to-name slot of Standard, MacRoman, WinAnsi, PDFDoc, Symbol and ZapfDingbats was compared with Annex D; MacExpert was also checked. This is not verification of Adobe Glyph List rules, TN5014 grammar or external font-program binary formats.

requirements.status: Type3 matrix, widths, procedures and resources
requirements.gaps: Glyph-procedure execution, d0/d1 checks and page-resource fallback are renderer responsibilities, not performed by PdfFont.

verification.rule: CharProcs names and complete Differences select procedures; FontMatrix transforms widths horizontally, out-of-range widths are zero, and missing Resources uses page resources.
verification.implementation: agrees for decoded widths, procedure identity and returned resource scope; d0/d1 execution is a renderer responsibility
verification.expectations: agrees, including rotation and the absence of an implicit default glyph

requirements.gaps: No differing Annex D code/name entry found; full AGL name-to-Unicode data is a separate pending dependency.

verification.rule: Only MacRoman, MacExpert and WinAnsi are named PDF simple encodings; Differences changes consecutive code/name slots over the specified or built-in base.
verification.implementation: all seven tables agree in all 256 slots; no differing entry; TrueType selection is tracked separately
verification.expectations: agrees in independent full-slot code/name vectors and existing codec-derived WinAnsi/MacRoman vectors

requirements.gaps: AGL-dependent names and character-collection-to-Unicode CMaps remain unbundled; the external grammar review remains pending.

verification.rule: ToUnicode takes priority, uses font-consistent code lengths and UTF-16BE sequences, increments the final bfrange byte, and uses only UseCMap from the stream dictionary.
verification.implementation: corrected irrelevant stream metadata and source-code-length consistency; AGL-derived rules remain pending primary-text review
verification.expectations: agree with the ISO rules, including minimized metadata/source-length violations; glyph-name known answers do not constitute AGL verification
choices: Empty ToUnicode destinations are retained as empty sequences because ISO specifies an upper size but no nonzero lower size.
Undefined bfrange overflow and mismatched array lengths are rejected with syntax errors.
Unrecognized name components contribute no Unicode, and entirely unknown names return None; this external AGL algorithm remains pending primary-text review.

requirements.status: Variable-length codespaces, CID maps, notdef, inheritance
requirements.gaps: TN5014 syntax/inheritance details remain pending primary-text review; the decoder supports declarative mappings, not general PostScript evaluation. Complete validation of every required CMap metadata entry is not claimed.

verification.rule: One-to-four-byte codespaces match per byte; missing glyphs consult notdef then CID 0, except an absent CIDToGIDMap stream entry requires CID 0 directly.
verification.implementation: corrected missing-stream-entry exception; supported ISO mapping subset agrees; TN5014 grammar/inheritance remains pending
verification.expectations: corrected by text/cid-map-missing-entry; existing bytewise, invalid-prefix and inheritance vectors agree
choices: Invalid strings ending before the chosen codespace length consume the remaining bytes.
Local CMap mappings override inherited mappings; later local definitions override earlier ones. The full TN5014 rule is pending primary-text review.

requirements.gaps: CIDs are bounded to 16 bits; the complete font-program metrics are not cross-validated against PDF dictionary widths.

verification.rule: DW/W and DW2/W2 define CID text-space metrics; default vertical origin x is half horizontal width; repeated W definitions use the first specification.
verification.implementation: agrees; W2 duplicate precedence follows the same first-definition choice
verification.expectations: agrees in list/range, overlap and default vectors
choices: For repeated W2 entries the first specification wins, matching the explicit W rule.

requirements.status: Explicit unavailable fonts and malformed mappings
requirements.gaps: Non-embedded fonts and predefined non-Identity CMaps remain unsupported under ADR 0009, including standard-14 fonts.

verification.rule: PDF permits non-embedded fonts and specifies predefined CMaps; missing local substitutes/data are explicit ADR 0009 capability limits.
verification.implementation: documented capability boundary, not a claim that ISO forbids those fonts or CMaps
verification.expectations: agrees with the explicit unsupported outcomes
choices: ADR 0009 excludes font substitution and predefined non-Identity CMap data until separately approved.

requirements.gaps: External font-program interpretation remains delegated; map entries are checked for usable glyph selectors during decoding.

verification.rule: Embedded CIDFontType2 requires Identity or a big-endian two-byte CIDToGIDMap; an absent stream entry selects the glyph for CID 0.
verification.implementation: corrected the absent-entry exception and the distinction between absent entries and explicit GID 0 mappings
verification.expectations: agrees after the minimized text/cid-map-missing-entry regression
choices: A present zero-valued CIDToGIDMap entry selects GID 0 and retains that CID; it is distinct from an absent entry, which requires CID 0.

requirements.gaps: Widths are interpreted from the PDF dictionary; agreement with every embedded program advance is not a complete conformance validation.

verification.rule: Widths cover FirstChar through LastChar; other simple codes use MissingWidth (default zero), while Type3 uses zero and its FontMatrix.
verification.implementation: agrees for the supported loaded font dictionaries
verification.expectations: agrees; PDF dictionary widths remain independent of glyph-outline bounds

requirements.status: Simple strings use one byte per glyph; composite strings use CMap codes; only single-byte code 32 is eligible for word spacing.
requirements.gaps: Text-state operators, BT/ET, positioning and painting belong to pagura-render and are outside this registry's execution tests.

verification.rule: Simple strings use one byte per glyph; composite strings use CMap codes; only single-byte code 32 is eligible for word spacing.
verification.implementation: ISO decoder interface agrees; text-state operator execution remains in pagura-render
verification.expectations: agree for raw text-space advances and word spacing on code 32 even when its glyph name is not space; a byte 32 inside a multi-byte code is ineligible
verification.verdict: ISO decoder interface agrees; text-state operator execution remains in pagura-render

requirements.status: Symbolic or unencoded fonts use direct symbol/Mac codes; encoded nonsymbolic fonts use names via Unicode, Mac OS Roman, then post.
requirements.gaps: Exact (3,1) selection for mixed/platform-0/full-Unicode records is blocked by the upstream record-classification issue in external_api_limits; those cases stay out of the manifest. Full AGL primary-text review remains pending.

verification.rule: Symbolic or unencoded fonts use direct symbol/Mac codes; encoded nonsymbolic fonts use names via Unicode, Mac OS Roman, then post.
verification.implementation: ISO selection routes implemented using the FontProgram subtable API; AGL lookup remains pending primary-text review
verification.expectations: agree for (3,1), (3,0) and (1,0) records, all Table 113 changes, post fallback, prefix cases and missing encodings; mixed-Unicode cases are excluded
verification.verdict: ISO routes agree under the documented subtable API contract; exact mixed-Unicode record selection remains blocked upstream
choices: When symbolic/no-Encoding wording overlaps the named/Nonsymbolic wording, the more specific direct-code paragraph takes precedence.
A present subtable does not fall through to another cmap on a missing glyph; name selection falls back to post, and raw selection defaults to .notdef.
The four allowed symbol high-byte ranges are tried in ascending order; a conforming symbol cmap uses one range.
When Mac OS Roman contains aliases for a name, the lowest character code is used.

requirements.status: PDF font descriptors bind Type1, TrueType, CFF and CID CFF programs; PDF widths supply advances and program matrices transform outlines.
requirements.gaps: External binary format primary texts are unavailable. PDF binding kind and declared length extents are checked; Type1 Length1/2 boundaries are not independently reconciled with parsed eexec boundaries, and OpenType outline technology is not independently classified here.

verification.rule: PDF font descriptors bind Type1, TrueType, CFF and CID CFF programs; PDF widths supply advances and program matrices transform outlines.
verification.implementation: ISO PDF bindings agree; binary font formats remain pending primary-text review
verification.expectations: agree for the accepted PDF bindings and minimized wrong-kind/length violations; program bytes and analytic glyphs are known-answer evidence, not external-format verification
verification.verdict: ISO PDF bindings agree; binary font formats remain pending primary-text review

requirements.status: Simple-font glyph names may supply Unicode through the external AGL algorithms.
requirements.gaps: pending primary-text review: Adobe Glyph List and Adobe Glyph List for New Fonts; only the implemented name repertoire and known-answer forms are covered.

verification.rule: Simple-font glyph names may supply Unicode through the external AGL algorithms.
verification.implementation: pending Adobe Glyph List primary-text review; numeric-name and ligature rules have known-answer coverage
verification.expectations: implementation agrees with explicit known-answer uni/u, suffix, underscore and legacy ligature forms; pending primary-text review, not verified against AGL
verification.verdict: pending Adobe Glyph List primary-text review; numeric-name and ligature rules have known-answer coverage
choices: Drop the suffix starting at the first period before interpreting names.
Unknown underscore components contribute no Unicode; recognized components are concatenated, with each numeric component validated atomically.
An entirely unknown glyph name returns None; an explicitly empty ToUnicode sequence remains Some(empty string).

primary_text_review.encoding_rule: D.2 assignments include WinAnsi bullet aliases, space/hyphen aliases, MacRoman currency and space; D.3 defines TAB/LF/CR; D.4-D.6 provide expert and symbolic assignments. No differing code-to-name entry was found.
primary_text_review.ownership_boundary: BT/ET, text-state operators, positioning and rendering are owned by pagura-render; this registry checks the font decoder interface and word-spacing eligibility, not execution of those operators.

pending_primary_text_review.standard: Adobe Glyph List and Adobe Glyph List for New Fonts
pending_primary_text_review.behaviour: Glyph-name scalars, legacy ligatures, suffix/underscore decomposition, uniXXXX and uXXXX[XX] names.
pending_primary_text_review.evidence: Independently specified known-answer name vectors and Annex D named characters; no differential results or AGL primary text reviewed.

pending_primary_text_review.standard: Adobe Technical Note #5014, Adobe CMap and CIDFont Files Specification
pending_primary_text_review.behaviour: Declarative CMap grammar, block counts, usecmap inheritance and duplicate-definition precedence beyond the PDF-specific rules.
pending_primary_text_review.evidence: Independently authored mapping vectors exercise the implemented subset; ISO 9.7.5.4, 9.7.6 and 9.10.3 verify only the stated PDF restrictions and mapping algorithm.

pending_primary_text_review.standard: Adobe Type 1 Font Format; Adobe Technical Notes #5176 (CFF) and #5177 (Type 2 charstrings)
pending_primary_text_review.behaviour: The independently generated embedded programs and delegated pagura-font parsing/charstring interpretation.
pending_primary_text_review.evidence: Existing independent font writers and analytic glyph expectations; ISO 9.9.1 Tables 124-125 verify PDF embedding bindings, not binary program formats.

pending_primary_text_review.standard: TrueType Reference Manual; ISO/IEC 14496-22:2019 Open Font Format
pending_primary_text_review.behaviour: sfnt/cmap/post binary layouts, unitsPerEm and font-program outline parsing.
pending_primary_text_review.evidence: Independent sfnt writer and known glyph IDs/outlines; ISO 9.6.5.4 verifies PDF selection routes, not the unavailable binary format specifications.

external_api_limits.contract: CmapSubtable::WindowsUnicode documents the (3,1) Windows BMP subtable.
external_api_limits.observed_implementation: sfnt/cmap.rs groups (0,*), (3,1) and (3,10) into WindowsUnicode and prefers higher numbered formats.
external_api_limits.impact: The text selection routes follow the documented enum contract; exact ISO 9.6.5.4 priority is not established for fonts containing these additional or mixed Unicode records.
external_api_limits.requested_api: Expose exact cmap record queries, e.g. has_cmap_record(platform: u16, encoding: u16) -> bool and glyph_for_cmap_record(platform: u16, encoding: u16, code: u32) -> Option<GlyphId>, or make WindowsUnicode mean (3,1) exactly and add separate enum variants.
excluded_vectors: (3,10) with (1,0) but no (3,1), which must use the Mac route
conflicting (3,1)/(3,10) records, which require exact (3,1) lookup
